threads.body: `notification_time_zone()` will raise a `ZoneInfoNotFoundError` with a fairly opaque message if `SLACK_NOTIFICATION_TIME_ZONE` is set to an invalid value. Since this is a new config surface, it’s better to fail with a clear `RuntimeError` that points to the env var name and value.

threads.body: Weekday suppression is now based on the configured notification timezone, but the follow-up interval check later in this function still uses `now.weekday() < 5` (UTC), which can reintroduce timezone-dependent behavior. Since this early return already enforces weekday-in-notification-timezone, the follow-up check should drop the extra `now.weekday()` condition (or switch it to `is_notification_weekday(now)`).

replies.body: No code change needed. The current branch already uses is_notification_weekday(now) for the follow-up condition.

threads.body: The PR description says follow-up scheduling uses a *configured* notification timezone (defaulting to America/Los_Angeles), but the code currently hard-codes the timezone to America/Los_Angeles with no configuration surface. Either the description should be updated, or the code should allow overriding the timezone (e.g., via an env var) while keeping America/Los_Angeles as the default.
